description: This source file implements a command-line tool for encoding and decoding PNG images to and from the ETC1 texture compression format. It includes functions for reading PNG files, writing PNG files, handling ETC1 encoding/decoding, and processing command-line arguments to perform the desired operation (encode/decode) with options such as headers and difference images.

methods.name: void usage(const char * message,...)
methods.description: Prints usage information and error messages for the command-line tool.

methods.name: int changeExtension(char * pPath,size_t pathCapacity,const char * pExtension)
methods.description: Changes the file extension of a given path string to a new extension.

methods.name: int fwrite_big_endian_uint16(png_uint_32 data,FILE * pOut)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer in big-endian byte order to a file.

methods.name: int fread_big_endian_uint16(png_uint_32 * data,FILE * pIn)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer in big-endian byte order from a file.

methods.name: int read_PNG_File(const char * pInput,etc1_byte ** ppImageData,etc1_uint32 * pWidth,etc1_uint32 * pHeight)
methods.description: Reads a PNG file into a buffer, extracting image data, width, and height.

methods.name: int readPKMFile(const char * pInput,etc1_byte ** ppImageData,etc1_uint32 * pWidth,etc1_uint32 * pHeight)
methods.description: Reads an ETC1 embedded PNG (PKM) file into a buffer, extracting image data, width, and height.

methods.name: int encode(const char * pInput,const char * pOutput,bool bEmitHeader,const char * pDiffFile)
methods.description: Encodes a PNG image to ETC1 format, with optional header and difference image generation.

methods.name: int writePNGFile(const char * pOutput,png_uint_32 width,png_uint_32 height,const png_bytep pImageData,png_uint_32 imageStride)
methods.description: Writes image data to a PNG file.

methods.name: int decode(const char * pInput,const char * pOutput)
methods.description: Decodes an ETC1 PKM file into a PNG image.

methods.name: void multipleEncodeDecodeCheck(bool * pbEncodeDecodeSeen)
methods.description: Ensures only one encode or decode operation is specified.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point for the command-line tool, parses arguments and orchestrates encode/decode operations.
